title: When the Machine Wakes Again
author: Jonah Dunmore
blurb: Gideon Dunmore, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
